title: Gemini 4 Neon or Gemini 4 Carbon: what each costs, before and after Carbon’s 1 December price rise
intro: Switch between Google’s new Neon model and Carbon, its top model, to see their API prices per million tokens on the Gemini API, and what Google says about cost per task.
note: Prices are Google’s standard paid-tier Gemini API rates per million tokens, from its pricing page on 19 November 2026; output includes thinking tokens. Neither model is on the free tier. The 32% figure is Google’s own, measured per task at Neon’s default high thinking level, and is not a price per token. Gemini app subscribers are not billed per token.
